title: Build New York while houses remain
description: Build New York while houses remain. New York's traffic justifies the third house while supply is available. The decision depends on house supply, immediate rent threat, and whether the reserve survives the build.

final_action.public_message: Building up my orange set with another house on each.
final_action.private_thought: Add one house to each orange property to increase rent while keeping even development. Cost $300, leaving $50 cash. No need to mortgage now.
